title: kb_pack and rag.py pack print a pack handle that a later call can name, and the mcp capture row keeps it
goal: rag.py pack and kb_pack print one line 'pack: P-<8 hex>', the hash of the questions, the pack arguments and the kb commit, so the same pack on the same commit gives the same handle on every server, stdio and kb_http.py alike, with no session; the server keeps handle -> {questions, printed lines, commit} under _cache/ for a bounded time and count (never committed); the mcp and kb_hook capture rows store the handle (ql_capture.pack_lines reads it), so distill can join a report to its lookup exactly; rag.py eval keeps passing every row and the eval's mean pack size grows by under 1%.

clauses.clause: rag.py pack and kb_pack print one line 'pack: P-<8 hex>', the hash of the questions, the pack arguments and the kb commit, so the same pack on the same commit gives the same handle on every server, stdio and kb_http.py alike, with no session
the server keeps handle -> {questions, printed lines, commit} under _cache/ for a bounded time and count (never committed)
the mcp and kb_hook capture rows store the handle (ql_capture.pack_lines reads it), so distill can join a report to its lookup exactly
rag.py eval keeps passing every row and the eval's mean pack size grows by under 1%

gates.question: Does AGENTS.md (4096-byte cap) name the pack handle line, or does the handle stay documented in kb/_self docs only?
options: name the handle in AGENTS.md with a cut elsewhere in the same commit: at most 4096 bytes

gates.question: What bounded time and count does the _cache/ pack-handle store keep?

notes: Premise: python3 _tools/rag.py pack 'Intune enrollment device limit' prints a coverage line, fact lines and a url footer, and no handle a later call could name; kb_mcp.py never sees session_id or prompt_id (kb/_self/querylog.md, Surfaces), so a report could join its lookup only by time window today. Planned 2026-10-13 (SP-waxgh3kg). Premise run on base: rag.py pack 'Intune enrollment device limit' printed coverage good, fact lines and a sources footer, and no pack handle line: reproduces. rag.py eval passes before the work by design: it pins that every row keeps passing once the handle line is added. Tests are named by -k, so extend an existing test's name with pack_handle (the test-id ceiling), not a new test; the tests live in _tools/test_live_kb.py (pack, kb_mcp) and _tools/test_redact.py (capture row), never _tools/tests.py (the runner). Gates answered at planning: AGENTS.md stays unchanged, store bound 7 days and 500 handles.
